meta.scope: frontend components, pages, routes, HTML apps

components.name: BottomNav
components.purpose: Fixed bottom tab bar — 8 tabs, icon + label, horizontal scroll, safe-area padding
components.visual_style: Dark bg, primary color active tab, gray inactive, fixed bottom, no-scrollbar overflow-x
components.interaction_style: One tap = one view switch; horizontal scroll for overflow
components.verdict: Best mobile nav component in the repo — clean, safe-area aware, zero entanglement.

components.name: MaatVerdict
components.purpose: Minimal status footer — two icons (Heart vs Feather) + one status line
components.visual_style: Thin fixed bottom bar, border-top primary, mono font, icon pair
components.interaction_style: Passive display only
components.verdict: Cleanest thing in the repo. Two icons + one statement + boundary line.

components.name: Isfet
components.purpose: Live price monitor — two cards with trend arrows, refresh button, critical alert
components.visual_style: Large mono prices, spinning refresh icon, trend arrows, conditional critical alert banner
components.interaction_style: Click refresh → simulated delay → update → alert if threshold crossed
components.verdict: Best live-data card pattern — spinning refresh + mono number + trend arrow + threshold alert.

components.name: Campfire
components.purpose: Input text → async classify → result card (anchored/burned status)
components.visual_style: Orange border-left, radial flame bg (opacity-10), animated flame during processing
components.interaction_style: Textarea → button → 1.5s processing state → result with frequency + status
components.verdict: Best input-process-result shell. Ritual framing adds warmth to a generic async-classification UX.

components.name: AgentCard
components.purpose: Entity card — gradient bg per agent, 5xl emoji, role text, status indicators, hover scale
components.visual_style: Full-height gradient, large emoji icon, CheckCircle status, ChevronRight reveal on hover
components.interaction_style: hover:scale-105 + shadow glow
components.verdict: Beautiful entity card pattern. Consolidate with SystemCard into single prop-driven EntityCard.

components.name: SystemCard
components.purpose: System status card — gradient bg, emoji icon, online/offline badge, hover scale
components.visual_style: Same pattern as AgentCard — gradient + emoji + CheckCircle/XCircle + ChevronRight
components.interaction_style: hover:scale-105
components.verdict: Identical pattern to AgentCard — merge these two components.

components.name: Harvest
components.purpose: Select target → trigger → interval progress bar fills → data table reveals
components.visual_style: Emerald scheme, horizontal-scroll pill selectors, animated progress bar, data grid
components.interaction_style: Pill select → button → setInterval progress → data populate on complete
components.verdict: Best progressive-reveal interaction. Pill selector + interval progress + table reveal = golden UX pattern.

components.name: Cosmos
components.purpose: Network map — 5 positioned nodes, SVG connection lines, click-to-reveal info tooltip
components.visual_style: Black radial bg, grid pattern, colored nodes, SVG lines opacity-30, backdrop-blur tooltip
components.interaction_style: Click node → tooltip slide-in with name/type/status/description
components.verdict: Best spatial navigation model. SVG lines + positioned nodes + click tooltip is a reusable spatial info pattern.

components.name: VESDashboard
components.purpose: Main hub — 3 stat cards + 6-system grid + 4 quick-action buttons
components.visual_style: Dark gradient (gray-900 → purple-900), backdrop-blur header, spinning refresh icon
components.interaction_style: 30s polling, loading state, quick-action view switching
components.verdict: Best dashboard layout. 3-stat row + card grid + quick-action buttons is reusable for any system hub.

components.name: AgentConsole
components.purpose: Two-state: agent selector grid → chat interface with role-colored messages
components.visual_style: Dark gradient header, agent grid, chat bubbles by role (cyan/white/yellow)
components.interaction_style: Select agent → enter chat → send → 1s reply → append
components.verdict: Best chat UI. Role-colored bubbles + two-state (select→chat) is clean production pattern.

components.name: CodexAccordion
components.purpose: Expandable knowledge entries with toggle and special glow on select entries
components.visual_style: Green/amber border-left, hz-432-glow animation on special entry, scroll-delay stagger
components.interaction_style: Click header → toggle expand/collapse
components.verdict: Best accordion/docs pattern — clean toggle, color-coded special entries, no library required.

components.name: GlitchNavBar
components.purpose: Top nav with VHS glitch logo + scan-lines effect
components.visual_style: Dark + green border, monospace, scan-lines overlay, data-text glitch CSS
components.interaction_style: Router links, hover transitions
components.verdict: Most visually distinctive nav. Glitch + scan-lines CSS is a direct steal.

components.name: CharacterHoverCard
components.purpose: Motion-animated popup card showing entity info on hover
components.visual_style: Scale/opacity framer-motion entrance, gradient bg, border effects
components.interaction_style: isVisible state → spring animation in/out
components.verdict: Elegant hover card. Translates to click-based on mobile with minor rework.

components.name: CharactersGrid
components.purpose: Responsive 3-column entity grid with corner-accent cards and stagger entrance
components.visual_style: Absolute-positioned corner border accents, staggered framer-motion, episode badge, group hover
components.interaction_style: hover:scale + color shift
components.verdict: Best grid card layout. Corner-accent + stagger entrance is strong for any entity list.

components.name: EpisodeSceneReader
components.purpose: Scene-by-scene narrative reader — prev/next, kino mode, localStorage progress
components.visual_style: Gradient progress bar, kino mode toggle, corner accents
components.interaction_style: Next/prev scene, kino toggle, localStorage save
components.verdict: Most interesting content navigation pattern. Scene reader with kino mode = genuine progressive disclosure.

components.name: ConstellationPulse
components.purpose: Full-screen animated starfield with orbiting pulsing nodes and hover reveal
components.visual_style: Static stars, colored pulsing nodes, hue-mapped box-shadow, hover label
components.interaction_style: setInterval phase loop for pulse, hover to reveal label/description
components.verdict: Most atmospheric component. Slow pulse loop on starfield = perfect idle/ambient background.

components.name: GhostlineChat
components.purpose: Persistent chat — session management, auto-scroll, localStorage, role-styled messages
components.visual_style: Role-styled messages, typing indicator (3-dot pulse)
components.interaction_style: Send → API → append → auto-scroll; localStorage session persistence
components.verdict: Best backend-wired chat. useRef auto-scroll + localStorage session is production-ready.

components.name: SystemHealthMonitor
components.purpose: Categorized service health grid with AbortSignal-timeout periodic polling
components.visual_style: Status badges (online/offline/checking), category headers, service links
components.interaction_style: 30s useEffect interval → AbortSignal(2s) per request → badge update
components.verdict: Best service monitoring pattern — AbortSignal + no-cors probe + badge is production-grade.

components.name: StatCardLogEntry
components.purpose: Static dashboard with neon-box glassmorphism, stat-card, and log-entry CSS patterns
components.visual_style: .neon-box (border cyan + backdrop-blur), .stat-card (border-left + translateX hover), .log-entry (border-left green)
components.interaction_style: Hover stat-card → translateX(5px)
components.verdict: .stat-card and .log-entry are the cleanest direct-copy CSS micro-patterns in the repo.

components.name: ManifestOrionLanding
components.purpose: Static portal landing — two navigation cards, clear two-option hierarchy
components.visual_style: Deep emerald radial gradient, JetBrains Mono + Inter, glassmorphism cards, .btn-portal
components.interaction_style: Card hover (translateY(-5px) + border-glow), .btn-portal hover
components.verdict: Cleanest static landing page. Card hover + btn-portal + emerald radial bg is directly portable.

components.name: GHOSTCOREVisualArchive
components.purpose: Minimal markdown book reader with status bar, live-dot indicator, keyboard shortcuts
components.visual_style: Border-left accent, pulsing live-dot, status bar (live + system-status + version)
components.interaction_style: Book click → load markdown; Ctrl+1/2/3 shortcuts; status bar updates
components.verdict: Status bar + live-dot + keyboard shortcut navigation are clean patterns worth lifting.

components.name: RattmannToggleList
components.purpose: Toggleable item list — protected/vulnerable states with glow feedback
components.visual_style: Amber accent, glow box-shadow on protected items, lock/unlock icons
components.interaction_style: Click toggle → flip state → recalculate rate
components.verdict: Clean toggleable item card. Glow-shadow on active state = warm, clear feedback.

components.name: MetricCard
components.purpose: Atomic metric card — icon + label + value, conditional highlight
components.visual_style: 2-column grid, border highlight on active, bold value
components.interaction_style: Live-update via useEffect on inputs
components.verdict: Most extraction-ready atomic component. Metric sub-component (icon+label+value) is universal.

components.name: NewsTicker
components.purpose: Scrolling horizontal text ticker — CSS-only 20s linear loop
components.visual_style: Accent-colored strip, whitespace-nowrap, @keyframes ticker
components.interaction_style: Passive/decorative
components.verdict: Zero-dep ticker. Steal the @keyframes ticker CSS block.

components.name: ArkhonTrinity
components.purpose: Web Audio API oscillator synthesis + canvas mandala visualization + ritual log
components.visual_style: 3 gradient arkhon cards, canvas mandala with glow (shadowBlur), scrollable ritual log
components.interaction_style: Click arkhon → oscillator plays + canvas draws + log appends
components.verdict: Most technically ambitious component. Study canvas + Web Audio pattern before any immersive interaction work.

components.name: TrinityTemple
components.purpose: 9-section shrine monolith — memorial, story, philosophy, layers, gallery, rituals
components.visual_style: Amber gradients, expandable layers, SVG constellation, embeds ConstellationPulse
components.interaction_style: Section navigation, expandable accordion layers
components.verdict: 800+ line switch-render monolith. Extract individual sub-patterns separately; never use as a unit.

components.name: ToneSimulator
components.purpose: Auto-updating doughnut chart + metrics sidebar + event feed log
components.visual_style: Chart.js Doughnut with overlay text, 2-col grid, scrollable event log
components.interaction_style: 2s interval auto-update, two action buttons, threshold alert
components.verdict: Too dense. The event feed sub-pattern is worth isolating; the full component is cognitively overloaded.

components.name: JustificationMetrics
components.purpose: Analytics dashboard with 4 stat cards + log table (all mock data)
components.visual_style: Green accent, dual-color progress bar, emoji indicators, hover log rows
components.interaction_style: Passive display
components.verdict: Unclear purpose + mock data + high load = no salvage value.

components.name: GhostcorePortal
components.purpose: Legacy duplicate of App.jsx with syntax error
components.visual_style: Same as App.jsx
components.interaction_style: Same as App.jsx
components.verdict: Delete this file. Broken copy of superseded code.

components.name: TrinityCommandCenter
components.purpose: Firebase-backed multi-tab dashboard with SVG network graph
components.visual_style: Sidebar + tabs, SVG clickable nodes, log viewer
components.interaction_style: Firebase auth, Firestore data, tab switching, SVG node click
components.verdict: SVG network graph is the only extractable pattern; buried under Firebase coupling.

best_reusable_components: C01 BottomNav — mobile tab bar, zero friction lift
C02 MaatVerdict — minimal status bar, two icons + one line
C03 Isfet — live-data card with refresh + threshold alert
C05/C06 AgentCard/SystemCard merged — entity card with gradient + emoji + status
C07 Harvest — pill selector + interval progress + data reveal
C11 CodexAccordion — clean toggle docs pattern, no library
C16 ConstellationPulse — ambient star + node pulse background
C17 GhostlineChat — backend-wired chat with role bubbles
C23 MetricCard — icon + label + value atomic component
best_visual_patterns: Campfire orange border-left + radial flame bg (opacity-10)
ConstellationPulse hue-mapped box-shadow on pulse loop
Isfet large mono price + trend arrow + conditional critical alert
best_navigation_ideas: BottomNav mobile tab bar with horizontal overflow scroll
VES Hub tab switching with active-tab border-bottom
best_docs_ux_patterns: CodexAccordion expandable entries color-coded special items
EpisodeSceneReader progressive chapter navigation + kino mode
Settings collapsible guides via HTML details elements
Status bar live-dot persistent system status
TrinityTemple sigil gallery visual index with hover descriptions
best_low_entropy_interactions: Isfet refresh one button one outcome
Campfire one textarea + one button = result
Challenge binary choice per screen deny/override
Episode prev/next one decision at a time
things_to_avoid: TrinityTemple as single component — 800+ line switch-render cathedral
ToneSimulator density — chart + metrics + live feed + 2 buttons simultaneously
JustificationMetrics — mock data masquerading as analytics
TrinityCommandCenter Firebase coupling — auth baked into render logic
VES Hub all-12-systems tab dump — dashboard worship
Hardcoded AGENT_INFO/SYSTEM_INFO lookup tables — defeats card reusability
OracleViewer graph placeholder — ships empty div as live visualization
Trivia.jsx all-in-one — game state + AI eval + tier grid + localStorage no seams
ArkhonTrinity in production UX — beautiful experiment, wrong tool for clarity

what_feels_alive: GHOSTLINE_MOBILE — most cohesive dark-but-warm design language; BottomNav/MaatVerdict/Isfet/Campfire/Rattmann are standalone atoms
CODEX VESApp — AgentCard/SystemCard/AgentConsole/Dashboard are structurally sound with extractable patterns
Manifest Orion — cleanest single page; two-card portal with zero ambiguity
digital-godzilla CSS — most visually distinctive; scan-lines + glitch + corner-accents are the most memorable patterns
fake_complexity: TrinityTemple — one 800-line component doing 9 unrelated things
OracleViewer — ships an empty div labeled live graph visualization
JustificationMetrics — hardcoded mock data presented as real analytics
ToneSimulator — three dashboards bolted together as one feature
VES Hub terminal input — fake command prompt runs no commands
never_reuse: JustificationMetrics — opaque + mock data + high load
TrinityCommandCenter — Firebase too embedded in render logic
AGENT_INFO/SYSTEM_INFO lookup tables as-is — replace with props before lifting cards
safest_next_adoption_steps: 1. Lift atoms: MetricCard, MaatVerdict, BottomNav — zero-risk extraction
3. Consolidate AgentCard + SystemCard into one prop-driven EntityCard — remove hardcoded lookup maps
4. Port Campfire shell — strip ritual content, keep idle→processing→result state machine
5. Study ArkhonTrinity — canvas mandala + Web Audio before any immersive interaction work
